name: Maybulk Berhad
overview: 2026年，Maybulk 的仓储与物流板块出现两项重大资产交易：持股60%的子公司 MBC Logistic Hub 拟以约 RM278.05 million 出售位于 Kapar 的约2,527,721平方英尺永久工业用地；同时全资子公司 MB Integrated Logistics 以 RM35.5 million 收购 Kapar 一幅约8,346平方米的永久工业用地及单层工业建筑与附属建筑。航运板块及其他板块在公告中未见具体业务变动。
overview_en: In 2026, Maybulk's warehousing and logistics segment saw two major asset transactions: its 60%-owned subsidiary MBC Logistic Hub proposed to dispose of approximately 2,527,721 square feet of freehold industrial land in Kapar for about RM278.05 million; meanwhile, wholly-owned subsidiary MB Integrated Logistics acquired a piece of freehold industrial land of approximately 8,346 square metres with a single-storey industrial building and an annexed building in Kapar for RM35.5 million.

segments.name: 仓储
segments.note: 今年进行一宗土地出售和一宗工业物业收购，均位于 Kapar。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment carried out one land disposal and one industrial property acquisition, both located in Kapar.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述收购的买卖协议所有先决条件于2026年10月29日达成，协议成为无条件。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent of the sale and purchase agreement for the above acquisition were fulfilled on 29 October 2026, and the agreement became unconditional.
